list.name: min_contract_value
list.label: Min contract value (EUR)
list.description: Minimum absolute contract value in EUR. Contracts with abs(preco_contratual) below this are hidden from every panel. It is applied to the absolute value, so large negative values are kept. It works on top of the fixed EUR 10 rule used at ingest (contracts below EUR 10 are already excluded). Options: 0 (no extra filter), 10, 5000, 20000, 75000. The default is 10.

list.name: contract_type
list.label: Contract type
list.query: Ajuste direto : ajuste_direto,Concurso público : concurso_publico,Consulta prévia : consulta_previa,Other : other
list.description: Procedure family (procedure_family, from contracts.tipo_procedimento). Other = every procedure outside the three named families.

panels.title: Supplier concentration: top-10 share of value

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT sum(a.preco_contratual) AS val FROM procurement.v_adjudicatario_contracts a WHERE a.adjudicante_id = '${adjudicante}' AND (a.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND a.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND abs(a.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('${contract_type:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR a.procedure_family = ANY(string_to_array('${contract_type:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY a.adjudicatario_id), t AS (SELECT val / nullif(sum(val) OVER (), 0) AS sh, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT sum(sh) FILTER (WHERE rn <= 10) AS top10_share FROM t

panels.description: Share of this buyer's spend that goes to its 10 largest suppliers.

panels.title: Supplier concentration: HHI

targets.rawSql: WITH s AS (SELECT sum(a.preco_contratual) AS val FROM procurement.v_adjudicatario_contracts a WHERE a.adjudicante_id = '${adjudicante}' AND (a.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND a.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND abs(a.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('${contract_type:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR a.procedure_family = ANY(string_to_array('${contract_type:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY a.adjudicatario_id), t AS (SELECT val / nullif(sum(val) OVER (), 0) AS sh, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS rn FROM s) SELECT sum(sh * sh) AS hhi FROM t

panels.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman index, sum of squared value shares (0-1). Above 0.25 is highly concentrated. Same measure as the concentration tables in procedures_comparison.ipynb.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 1000 THEN '1) < 1k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 5000 THEN '2) 1k-5k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 20000 THEN '3) 5k-20k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 75000 THEN '4) 20k-75k' WHEN abs(v.preco_contratual) < 250000 THEN '5) 75k-250k' ELSE '6) >= 250k' END AS band, count(DISTINCT v.idcontrato) AS contracts FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v WHERE v.adjudicante_id = '${adjudicante}' AND (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('${contract_type:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.procedure_family = ANY(string_to_array('${contract_type:csv}', ','))) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: The table below is capped at LIMIT 5000 rows, newest first; this count makes a silent truncation visible.

targets.rawSql: SELECT v.celebrated_at AS "Date", a.adjudicatario_names AS "Adjudicatário(s)", v.objecto_contrato AS "Objecto", v.preco_contratual AS "Preço", v.preco_total_efetivo AS "Preço efetivo", v.prazo_execucao AS "Prazo (d)", v.valor_por_dia AS "EUR/dia", v.tipo_procedimento AS "Procedimento", v.cpv AS "CPV", v.idcontrato AS "ID" FROM procurement.v_contracts_material v LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT string_agg(a2.adjudicatario_name, ', ' ORDER BY a2.adjudicatario_name) AS adjudicatario_names FROM procurement.v_contract_adjudicatario a2 WHERE a2.idcontrato = v.idcontrato) a ON true WHERE v.adjudicante_id = '${adjudicante}' AND (v.celebrated_at >= date_trunc('day', $__timeFrom()::timestamp) AND v.celebrated_at < date_trunc('day', $__timeTo()::timestamp) + interval '1 day') AND abs(v.preco_contratual) >= ${min_contract_value} AND ('${contract_type:csv}' = '__ALL__' OR v.procedure_family = ANY(string_to_array('${contract_type:csv}', ','))) ORDER BY v.celebrated_at DESC LIMIT 5000
